Build a Small Status API

In this tutorial you will create a small status endpoint, verify its response, and understand each part of the implementation.

Prerequisites

  • Node.js 20 or newer
  • A terminal

Implementation

  1. Create a project directory.
  2. Install the server dependency.
  3. Add the endpoint shown below.
const status = { ok: true }
console.log(status)
Keep the endpoint free of secrets and user-specific information.

Configuration

OptionPurpose
PORTListening port
HOSTListening address

Run the application and request the endpoint to confirm that it returns a successful response before deployment.

You can now integrate the status endpoint with a monitoring service while keeping the implementation intentionally small.
